All `224` methods in the `ar9300_hal_template` vtable (`.rodata+0x06b8..0x0a38`) access MAC/BB/PHY registers through these two functions (`498` total call sites in `ath_hal.ko`).
executive_summary.sc_ops_and_wmi_htt_dispatch_resolved: CONFIRMED (proprietary airMAX/LTU module + QCA firmware): In `ath_dev.ko`, `ath_dev_attach` (`0x00f3bc`) populates `sc_ops` dynamically (`0x00faf0..0x00fb58`), binding `sc_ops->get_config_param = ath_get_config` (`0x023d10`) at `sc_ops+0x208` and `sc_ops->set_config_param = ath_set_config` (`0x0234c8`) at `sc_ops+0x20c` (`217`-entry jump table at `.rodata+0x000d60` -> `sc->sc_ah` at `0x2980($sc)` -> `ar9300_hal_template`). In `umac.ko`, `wlan_set_param` (`0x003210`, `155`-entry jump table at `.rodata+0x000300`), `ol_ath_vap_set_param` (`0x0ad820`, `155`-entry jump table at `.rodata+0x0c870` -> `wmi_unified_vdev_set_param_send` `0x0ad77c`, `WMI_VDEV_SET_PARAM_CMDID = 0x901a`), and `ol_ath_set_config_param` (`0x0b3308`, `161`-entry jump table at `.rodata+0x0d620` -> `wmi_unified_pdev_set_param` `0x0a80f4`, `WMI_PDEV_SET_PARAM_CMDID = 0x9006` + `htt_h2t_aggr_cfg_msg` `0x0d5a2c` `HTT_H2T_MSG_TYPE_AGGR_CFG = 0x07`) dispatch all `340` `airos_ioctl + hardware` knobs (`438` total including `68` `airos_sysctl` -> `WMI_UBNT_HT_COMM_CMDID = 0x9065` at `0x0b4910` and `30` `airos_module` params).
